_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior door repaint. Context prefix DRRP (DooR RePaint) — no collision with existing prefixes (FRAME, DOOR, TRRP, SDNG, FCSD, WSRP, etc.). Combined assess+prep+prime+finish in single spec. EA-based estimation — doors counted individually. Three substrate materials (steel, fiberglass, wood) as primary branching dimension. Three substrate states (sound, failing, rust). QT3-QT5 range (QT2 excluded — doors are fine-finish substrate). Brush is primary application method; spray conditional on door removal.

paintable_items.name: Exterior door unit (slab + frame/jamb + edges)
paintable_items.notes: NEW exterior item. Covers complete door unit: slab face, frame/jamb, hinge/latch/top/bottom edges. EA-based — each door is a self-contained work unit with hardware removal, prep, prime, coat, and hardware reinstall. Distinct from ITM_DOOR_FRAME_SET (interior) and ITM_DOOR_SLAB_INT (if it existed). Includes six-side sealing for wood doors. Grand entry includes sidelite/transom glass masking as sub-tasks.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR (interior slab), CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, WSRP, TRRP. DRRP is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_DRRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_DRRP_ASSESS_CONDITION, TSK_DRRP_REMOVE_HARDWARE, TSK_DRRP_CLEAN_STEEL, TSK_DRRP_CLEAN_FIBERGLASS, TSK_DRRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER, TSK_DRRP_RUST_DEBRIDE, TSK_DRRP_BODY_FILL, TSK_DRRP_PRIME_BRUSH, TSK_DRRP_PRIME_SPRAY, TSK_DRRP_FINISH_BRUSH_1, TSK_DRRP_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_DRRP_MASK_GLASS, TSK_DRRP_WEATHERSTRIP_PROTECT, TSK_DRRP_REINSTALL_HARDWARE, TSK_DRRP_CAULK_FRAME

expected_modules.notes: Condition assessment — visual inspection, adhesion test (tape test), rust evaluation (steel), outgassing history (fiberglass), moisture content (wood), existing coating ID (solvent test). MANDATORY first module for repaint. Fixed time 0.25-0.50 hrs/EA. Results determine prep scope, primer selection, and complexity.
Door removal from frame (optional for brush, required for spray and six-side seal on wood). Grand entry may require 2-person crew. Weatherstrip pull-out or deep-tape.
Protection setup — ground cover, threshold protection, glass masking (panel/grand_entry), siding masking (spray only). Hardware removal is part of this module.
Remove ALL locking hardware, strike plates, hinges, address numbers. MANDATORY for repaint (masking discouraged). Fixed time 0.25-0.50 hrs/EA. Areas beneath hardware must be sealed.

Surface preparation — substrate-material-driven branching. Steel: solvent+TSP clean, sand/debride rust. Fiberglass: mild soap/alcohol clean ONLY (NO sanding on textured). Wood: TSP wash, sand, six-side access. Scrape failing areas, feather-sand edges. Body filler at QT4+ for imperfections.

Primer application — substrate-material-driven. Steel sound = acrylic DTM. Steel rust = zinc-rich epoxy. Galvanized = acrylic etching. Fiberglass = 100% acrylic only (oil PROHIBITED). Wood = standard acrylic or stain-block. Spot prime if sound, full prime if >30% bare or failing.
Intercoat inspection and light sand. QT4: sand between finish coats (150-grit). QT5: sand between ALL coats (180-220 grit). Skipped at QT3.
First finish topcoat. Brush (primary) or spray. Steel limited to satin or lower per ANSI A250.8 (max 20% reflectance). Fiberglass: 100% acrylic latex enamel only.
Second finish topcoat. All tiers (QT3/QT4/QT5) receive 2 finish coats. QT5 grand entry may receive 3 coats.
Reinstall all hardware after final coat is dry. Verify alignment and operation. Fixed time 0.25-0.50 hrs/EA.
Protection teardown, weatherstrip re-insert, door rehang (if removed), site cleanup, tool cleaning. RRP adds lead-safe waste disposal when pre-1978.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of exterior doors to repaint. Primary quantity input. Each door counted individually.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — exterior door repaint count. Distinct from PS_SURFACE_EA_SIDE.DOOR_SLAB (interior slabs counted by side) and PS_SURFACE_EA.DOOR_FRAME_SET (interior frames). Exterior doors counted as complete units (slab + frame + edges).

paintscope_keys.description: Count of hardware sets to remove/reinstall. Typically equals door count but may differ if some doors have already had hardware removed.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — hardware removal is mandatory (masking discouraged). Each hardware set includes lockset, deadbolt, hinges, strike plates, address numbers.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of glass lites in door assemblies requiring masking. Slab = 0, panel = 0-1, grand entry = 4-8.
paintscope_keys.notes: Proposed by SF_TRIM_EXT_RP sibling. REUSE if already registered. Covers all glass lites in door + sidelite + transom assembly.

paintscope_keys.description: Total count of individual glass lites across all doors. Drives glass masking task quantity.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — per-project total. Grand entry with sidelites and transom may have 4-8 lites per assembly.

paintscope_keys.description: Door substrate material: steel, fiberglass, wood. Primary branching dimension. Per-door attribute.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — drives cleaning protocol, sanding constraints, primer chemistry, topcoat chemistry, and failure mode risk.

paintscope_keys.description: Door complexity: slab, panel, grand_entry. Drives production rate selection and repaint premium multiplier.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — per-door attribute. Grand entry includes sidelites and transom. Restoration is the extreme end of grand_entry at QT5.

paintscope_keys.description: Existing coating condition: SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT, SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST. Drives prep scope and primer requirements.
paintscope_keys.notes: NEW — per-door attribute. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only (per RC-001).

paintscope_keys.description: Ground surface area under door work zone requiring protection. Drop cloth for brush, full tarp for spray.
Boolean flag for pre-1978 building. Triggers EPA Lead-Safe RRP requirements.
paintscope_keys.notes: Proposed by SF_SIDING_WOOD_EXT_RP and SF_TRIM_EXT_RP — shared repaint gate condition. REUSE if already registered.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded — doors are fine-finish substrate, even budget repaint requires hardware removal, proper prep, and two coats. QT5 valid for restoration and grand entry doors.

application_method.notes: Brush is primary for single-door repaint (detail work). Spray viable when door removed and set on sawhorses. No brush_roll — doors are not roller surfaces. No backbrushing needed on doors (unlike wood siding).

sheen.notes: Exterior door sheens. Steel limited to satin or lower per ANSI A250.8 (max 20% reflectance at 60 degrees — high gloss emphasizes factory imperfections). Wood and fiberglass: satin (QT3), semi-gloss (QT4), gloss (QT5).

phase.notes: Combined spec — uses prime and finish directly, not apply. Assess module uses prep phase. Hardware removal/protection uses setup phase. Hardware reinstall uses cleanup phase.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA is primary UOM for all door tasks (per-door rates). FIXED for project-level tasks (lead evaluation, RRP containment). No SF or LF tasks — doors are EA-based.

substrate_state.notes: 3 repaint input states. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT and SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT exist in controlled_enums.json. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is PROPOSED (steel-only, per RC-001). Output varies by sheen. SS_EXT_CHALKING and SS_EXT_PEELING excluded — uncommon on doors (more of a siding phenomenon).

door_substrate_material.notes: PROPOSED enum type — not in controlled_enums.json. Primary branching dimension for this spec. Drives cleaning protocol, sanding constraints, primer type, topcoat chemistry.

door_complexity.notes: PROPOSED enum type — not in controlled_enums.json. Drives production rate selection and repaint premium. Grand entry includes sidelites + transom. Restoration (12-20 hrs) is grand_entry at QT5.

product_role.notes: Primer and finish primary. Specialty for IR-reflective coating (LRV <30) and body filler.

protection_level.notes: Subset needed. full_cover for hardware removal zones and glass masking. edge_only for ground drop cloth (brush). light_mask for threshold and siding adjacent. full_mask not typically needed — doors are small scope.

condition_scale.notes: Universal condition scale for doors. GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x. SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is a separate steel-only axis (2.0x) not part of universal scale.

surface_ids.notes: Primary surface door_slab_ext is PROPOSED — not in id_registry surface_ids. Adjacent: ext_trim_door_casing and siding_field exist in registry. door_frame_ext and ext_threshold are PROPOSED. door_frame_ext is same-scope (painted as part of door unit). ext_trim_door_casing is separate spec (trim). ext_threshold is protection target only.

zone_ids.notes: Hardware REMOVAL is the standard (not masking). All locking hardware, strike plates, hinges, address numbers removed. Existing zone_id — reused from interior door spec.
Glass lites in panel and grand entry doors. Masking paper or tape. Existing zone_id from interior window spec.
NEW — weatherstrip pull-out or deep-tape protection. Fixed time per door. Specific to exterior door repaint.
NEW — door threshold/sill plate protection. Tape and paper to prevent drips. Fixed per door.
Ground surface under door work zone. Existing zone_id. Upgrades from edge_only (brush) to full_cover (spray on sawhorses).
NEW — siding adjacent to door opening. Masking when application_method = spray. Not needed for brush.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_PRIMER_STEEL_DTM — interior rust-inhibitive DTM primer for steel windows. Same product class — may be reusable for factory-primed steel door sound repaint.
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — bonding primer for smooth/hard substrates. Used in cabinet spec. May apply for factory-finished fiberglass doors.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — NC acrylic primer for bare exterior wood. Reusable for wood door bare areas.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_TANNIN — NC tannin-blocker. Reusable for tannin-rich wood door species.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — NC QT3 exterior finish. Same product class for door QT3.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM — NC QT4 exterior finish. Same product class for door QT4.
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_SUPERIOR — NC QT5 exterior finish. Same product class for door QT5.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic DTM Primer for Factory-Primed/Sound Steel
proposed_systems.notes: Universal acrylic DTM for steel doors with existing sound coating. Spot prime thin or bare areas only.

proposed_systems.name: Zinc-Rich Epoxy/Alkyd Primer for Bare/Rusted Steel
proposed_systems.notes: Sacrificial barrier primer for debrideed steel. Applied to bare metal after SSPC-SP3/SP6 rust removal. Zinc-rich epoxy or alkyd. Critical for corrosion prevention.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Etching Primer for Galvanized Steel
proposed_systems.notes: Vinyl wash or acrylic etching primer for galvanized/aluminum steel doors. Chemical bond promotion on non-ferrous metal.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Acrylic Exterior Primer for Wood Doors
proposed_systems.notes: General-purpose acrylic primer for wood door bare areas. Non-tannin species. Spot or full prime depending on bare area percentage.

proposed_systems.name: Stain-Blocking Primer for Tannin-Rich Wood Doors
proposed_systems.notes: Alkyd or shellac stain-blocker for cedar, redwood, mahogany, or other tannin-rich species. Required when tannin bleed visible on existing coating.

proposed_systems.name: 100% Acrylic Exterior Enamel (All Substrates)
proposed_systems.notes: Standard exterior door finish for all three substrate materials. QT3 = standard product (SW SuperPaint). QT4 = premium (SW Duration, BM Aura). QT5 = superior (SW Emerald). Steel limited to satin sheen per ANSI A250.8. Fiberglass: 100% acrylic mandatory (oil prohibited).

proposed_systems.name: IR-Reflective Coating for Dark Colors (LRV <30)
proposed_systems.notes: Conditional — replaces standard finish when LRV <30 on high-sun-exposure doors. IR-reflective 'cool paint' pigments drop surface temp 20-30 degrees F. Prevents wood joint failure, steel thermal warping, fiberglass outgassing. Material upcharge, not labor change.

material_system_prefix.notes: 5 primer systems (DTM, zinc-rich, etching, acrylic, stain-block) + 2 finish systems (standard acrylic, IR-reflective). Primer selection driven by substrate_material AND substrate_state. Finish product class is always 100% acrylic — same across all substrate materials. QT drives product grade.

proposed_consumables.name: 80-Grit Sandpaper (Rust/Heavy Prep)
proposed_consumables.notes: Coarse grit for aggressive steel rust removal and heavy prep.

proposed_consumables.name: 300-Grit Sandpaper (Feather Sanding)
proposed_consumables.notes: Fine grit for feathering paint edges around rust spots and transitions.

proposed_consumables.name: 2-Component Auto-Body Filler
proposed_consumables.notes: For steel door dents and QT5 surface perfection. Not a paint product — auto-body supply.

proposed_consumables.name: Exterior Flexible Paintable Caulk (Polyurethane/Hybrid MS)
proposed_consumables.notes: Door-to-frame junction caulk replacement. Exterior-grade, paintable.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip (Door Application)
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard tip for spraying removed doors on sawhorses. Moderate fan pattern.

proposed_consumables.name: 6-Mil Poly Sheeting (RRP Containment)
proposed_consumables.notes: Lead-safe containment. Conditional — only when PRE_1978 = true.

proposed_consumables.name: Lead-Safe Waste Disposal Bag
proposed_consumables.notes: Lead-safe waste collection. Conditional — only when PRE_1978 = true.

proposed_modifiers.description: Quality tier rate modifier on coating tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: qt_scaled coating tasks (prime, finish). QT3 = baseline (standard product + 2 coats). QT4 = premium (premium product + raking light inspection + 2 coats). QT5 = superior (sanding between coats + possible 3 coats + perfection standard).

proposed_modifiers.description: Door complexity multiplier on all tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL tasks (prep + coating). Slab = flat face, minimal detail. Panel = recesses, raised profiles, multiple edges. Grand entry = sidelites + transom + complex geometry + multiple glass lites.

proposed_modifiers.description: Substrate condition modifier on prep tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL prep tasks (cleaning, scraping, sanding, debridement). Does NOT apply to coating tasks — once prepped, surface is at baseline.
proposed_modifiers.notes: SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is steel-only. Rust debridement (SSPC-SP3/SP6) is highly labor-intensive.

proposed_modifiers.description: Lead-safe RRP modifier on prep tasks
proposed_modifiers.applies_to: ALL prep tasks involving paint disturbance (scraping, sanding, power tool cleaning). Adds containment, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, lead-safe disposal overhead.
proposed_modifiers.notes: Gate condition triggered by IN_BOOL_PRE_1978 = true. Per door where paint disturbance exceeds 2 SF on exterior component.

stacking_partition.formula: Effective Rate = Baseline Rate / (Pool_Modifiers x SHARED_Modifiers)
stacking_partition.max_theoretical_stack: Rust (2.00) x RRP (2.00) x Grand Entry (2.00) = 8.00x on prep tasks. EXCEEDS 4.0x flag threshold. Grand entry + rust + RRP is an extreme edge case — recommend T&M for this combination.
stacking_partition.notes: PREP pool applies to prep tasks only. COATING pool applies to coating tasks only. SHARED applies to all tasks. Stacking is multiplicative within and across pools. Typical worst case: Failing (1.50) x Grand Entry (2.00) = 3.00x on prep — well within range.

proposed_configurations.description: Spot prime (bare areas only) + 2 finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Standard repaint on sound paint. Spot prime thin/bare areas. Full prime not needed if adhesion passes.

proposed_configurations.description: Spot prime + 2 finish coats with interstage sand between finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Premium/superior on sound paint. QT5 adds second primer coat and sanding between all coats.
Failing paint — spot or full prime depending on bare area percentage. QT5 adds second primer coat.

proposed_configurations.description: Zinc primer on bare metal + DTM on surrounding + 2 finish coats
proposed_configurations.notes: Steel-only. Zinc-rich primer on debrided bare metal. Acrylic DTM on surrounding sound areas. 2 finish coats. QT5 adds sanding between all coats.

proposed_profiles.description: DTM/Zinc primer coverage on steel door surfaces
proposed_profiles.notes: Complex door geometry reduces effective coverage 20-30% vs flat wall. Adjust per manufacturer TDS.

proposed_profiles.description: Acrylic/stain-block primer coverage on wood door surfaces
proposed_profiles.notes: Wood porosity varies by species. Bare end-grain absorbs significantly more product.

proposed_profiles.description: Acrylic enamel finish coverage on all door substrates
proposed_profiles.notes: Doors have complex geometry (panels, recesses, edges). Factor 20-30% lower coverage per gallon vs flat wall.

coordination_notes: Door casing/trim painting — owned by SF_TRIM_EXT_RP. Clean junction at casing-to-jamb boundary.
Adjacent siding painting — owned by siding spec. Protection only during door spray work.
Door-to-casing junction caulking: caulk application owned by THIS spec (door side), casing surface prep owned by trim spec.
Lead-safe RRP containment: if multiple exterior repaint specs active on same entry area, containment setup may be shared across specs.
Grand entry sidelite glass masking: owned by this spec if sidelites are part of the door assembly. Independent fixed windows transfer to window spec.

materials_json.notes: HARD BLOCKER: SYS_ for fiberglass substrate must be 100% acrylic only. Oil-based products prohibited. Enforce in material_systems via applies_when constraint.

sop_modules_json.notes: Substrate-material-driven task branching: steel cleaning (solvent+TSP) vs fiberglass cleaning (mild soap only) vs wood cleaning (TSP). Use applies_when on tasks to branch by substrate_material.

production_json.notes: EA-based rates (hrs/EA). All tasks use EA or FIXED UOM. Factor modifiers (FAC_DRRP_*) are separate from base rates.

qa_report_json.notes: Verify: fiberglass oil blocker enforced in materials. Verify: SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST only applies to steel substrate. Verify: hardware removal (not masking) is the standard.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: TSK_ prefix DRRP must be used for ALL task IDs in sop_modules and production
RULE 10: ITM_DOOR_EXT must use exact ID in spec.json (no synonyms or re-derivations)
RULE 11: Downstream agents use ONLY enum values from this resolution — not raw controlled_enums.json
migration_warnings: SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is a PROPOSED substrate state not yet in controlled_enums.json. Must be added to registry before this spec can be finalized.
door_substrate_material and door_complexity are PROPOSED enum types not yet in controlled_enums.json. Must be added.

This is the first repaint spec for doors. Patterns established here (hardware removal as standard, substrate-material branching, complexity-based repaint premium) should be documented for future door-related specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Door Repaint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for repaint of existing exterior entry doors. No existing SF_ covers this scope. Distinct from SF_DOOR_SLAB_INT_NC (interior NC) and SF_DOOR_FRAME_NC_FINISH (interior frame finish).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door unit (slab + frame/jamb + edges)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing ITM_ covers exterior door as a complete unit. ITM_DOOR_FRAME_SET is interior frame only. The exterior door is a self-contained EA work unit including slab, frame, and all edges.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door count
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing PS_ key for exterior door opening count. PS_OPENING_EA.DOOR_OPENINGS_TOTAL is interior. New exterior-domain key needed.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door hardware set count for removal
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing PS_ key for exterior door hardware removal count. Hardware removal is mandatory for door repaint.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Total glass lite count across all doors
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing PS_ key for door glass lite counting. Needed for glass masking task quantity on panel and grand entry doors.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door substrate material enum input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum input for substrate material (steel/fiberglass/wood). Primary branching dimension with no existing equivalent.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door complexity enum input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum input for complexity level (slab/panel/grand_entry). Drives production rate selection.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door substrate state enum input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New per-door enum input for existing coating condition. Similar to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_STATE from siding repaint but door-specific (includes SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST for steel).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door count input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maps to PS_EXT_OPENING_EA.DOOR_EXT. No existing IN_ for exterior door count.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door hardware set count input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maps to PS_EXT_PROTECT_EA.DOOR_HARDWARE. No existing IN_ for door hardware removal count.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Total glass lite count input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maps to PS_EXT_META.EA.DOOR_GLASS_LITES. No existing IN_ for door glass lite count.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door substrate material enum input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maps to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_TYPE_DOOR. No existing IN_ for this.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door complexity enum input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maps to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.DOOR_COMPLEXITY. No existing IN_ for door complexity.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Door substrate state enum input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maps to PS_EXT_META.ENUM.SUBSTRATE_STATE_DOOR. No existing IN_ for door-specific substrate state.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior surface rust (active oxidation on steel)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Steel-only substrate state. Active oxidation requiring SSPC-SP3/SP6 debridement. Fundamentally different prep pathway from failing paint. Not in current controlled_enums.json substrate_state valid_values.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door substrate material enum type
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New enum type with values: steel, fiberglass, wood. Primary branching dimension for exterior door specs. Not an existing enum type in controlled_enums.json.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door complexity enum type
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New enum type with values: slab, panel, grand_entry. Drives production rate selection and repaint premium. Not an existing enum type.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door slab face surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing surface_id for exterior door slab. door_leaf_face is interior. Need ext distinction.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door frame/jamb surface

registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix DRRP for all modules in this spec. 11 modules expected.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec-specific material systems. 5 primers (DTM, zinc, etch, acrylic, stain-block) + 2 finishes (standard acrylic, IR-reflective). Substrate-material-driven primer selection unique to this spec.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT3=1.00, QT4=1.25, QT5=1.50 on coating tasks. Spec-specific modifier.

registry_additions_proposed.justification: sound=1.00, failing=1.50, rust=2.00 on prep tasks. Spec-specific — SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST is unique to doors.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Lead-safe RRP modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: none=1.00, tested_positive=2.00 on prep tasks. Same pattern as TRRP sibling but door-specific context.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door repaint round configurations (4 configs)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: 4 round configs: SOUND_QT3, SOUND_QT45, FAILING, RUST. Spec-specific coat sequence patterns tied to substrate state.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior door repaint coverage profiles (3 profiles)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: 3 profiles: PRIMER_STEEL, PRIMER_WOOD, FINISH. Door geometry reduces coverage 20-30% vs flat wall.
